# POP3 unused-value acceptance leaves the parser-fallback comment questioned

The assigned nsPop3Sink::IncorporateBegin cleanup only removes an overwritten rv = NS_OK assignment after parser initialization fails. In actual submitted inline1303508 on D234305, BenC doubts the existing comment that processing can continue without the parser, asks what that would accomplish without adding the message to the database, and explicitly defers the issue to header-parser refactoring. The inline remains NotDone while the small cleanup is accepted. Fixed source still has the parser-fallback comment and continues to mailbox metadata writes. Acceptance does not validate that questioned comment or complete a parser redesign. Existing code/error-policy analysis is reused; this addendum preserves the distinct deferred review concern. Shared Bug 1941552 lacks comment25, so this partial finding adds no complete-audit credit or claim that parserless execution is safe or broken. No parser/mailbox failure injection, runtime, build or tests ran.

Scope: Historical POP3 parser review outcome.
